exact_statement: For EVERY nonconstant Boolean core g on s>=1 bits and every integer L>=1, introduce L fresh positive private variables for each false core point v and take F_L=2 product_{v:g(v)=-1,l}(a_v(z) OR x_vl)-1, where a_v is the signed core clause false exactly at v. All private bits are relevant, the displayed CNF is irredundant and each displayed clause is a prime implicate (not necessarily the complete prime table). With q=Pr[g=-1] and epsilon=2^-L, every nonempty core-only coefficient is (1-epsilon)ghat(S), the empty coefficient is (1-epsilon)ghat(empty)+epsilon, and I(F_L)=(1-epsilon)^2 I(g)+2qepsilon[s(1-epsilon)+L]. Every nonempty private Fourier set lies in one private group, with coefficient magnitude 2^(1-s)epsilon for every core set; all cross-group private coefficients vanish. Thus private spectral mass is 4qepsilon(1-epsilon), its entropy is that mass times(2s+2L-2), H(F_L)->H(g), and H(F_L)/I(F_L)->H(g)/I(g). The supremum H/I on this actual signed-core positive-private clause family equals that over ALL Boolean functions, so same-constant FEI on this family is equivalent to full FEI. For ANY fixed normalized or subprobability nonempty reference R covering F_L, with core-sector mass Z_c>0 and r_c=R_core/Z_c, the EXACT extraction identity is C_g(r_c)=C_core(F_L;R)/(1-epsilon)^2+Var(g)log2 Z_c. The NEGATIVE normalization is retained. For the finite L=4s+4, C(F_L;R)<=K I(F_L) implies C_g(r_c)<=2K I(g). No influence-paid R for arbitrary cores is constructed, and no equivalence for all-positive core anchors or FEI resolution is claimed.
